question: Should the gateway JSON message/reason fields touched by this PR become locale-dependent display text, or should those protocol-facing fields stay stable while UI layers localize them?
rationale: The diff keeps stable codes/types but localizes human-readable gateway fields that existing clients may still consume; repository policy treats gateway/protocol compatibility as a maintainer decision when green CI cannot prove the client contract.

options.title: Keep Protocol Fields Stable
options.body: Preserve stable gateway message/reason text or add separate localized display fields, then localize only the UI-facing presentation path.

options.title: Accept Localized Display Fields
options.body: Maintainership can decide those fields are display-only and accept locale-dependent text as long as codes/types remain the supported contract.

options.title: Defer Gateway Localization
options.body: Land agent/runtime channel copy first and leave gateway JSON field localization for a narrower follow-up with protocol/client proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol Fields Stable
recommendation.body: Preserve stable gateway message/reason text or add separate localized display fields, then localize only the UI-facing presentation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the wizard i18n surface he merged and the conservative gateway/protocol compatibility policy in the repository.
